page_title: BUR 0-2 BOU | Burnley v Bournemouth 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
90+5' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Neto is alert and denies him.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) has replaced Josh Cullen.
90' Here's the change. Dara O'Shea leaves the pitch and Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
89' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Dominic Solanke is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
89' Milos Kerkez will be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).

88' 0 - 2 GOAL 0:2! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
85' Burnley take a short corner kick.
85' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Smith (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and David Coote didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
81' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
81' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Datro Fofana (Burnley). The referee signals a corner kick to Burnley.
77' Substitution. Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) has come on for Vitinho.
76' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
75' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
74' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is adjudged offside.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is replacing Justin Kluivert.
71' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
71' A quickly taken corner by Burnley.
71' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Burnley will have a corner.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacob Bruun Larsen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley).
68' The referee can't ignore those comments and Vitinho (Burnley) sees a yellow card for bad language.
68' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
67' The Josh Cullen (Burnley) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee David Coote rules it out for a foul.
63' Josh Cullen (Burnley) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Neto.
60' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
57' Good chance! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
56' James Trafford pulls off a great save to deny Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
55' Great teamplay by Burnley as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
51' Josh Cullen (Burnley) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) heads on.
48' Flag up against Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' Andoni Iraola has made a change at the break. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) has come on in place of Ryan Christie.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' David Coote blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner with a short pass.

45+5' Vitinho (Burnley) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Burnley.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Now Bournemouth have a corner.

45+1' Vitinho (Burnley) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' Vitinho (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Burnley will take a corner.
45' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) fires the resulting free kick to the top right corner from the edge of the box, but Neto pulls off a superb save to deny him.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
41' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is booked after bringing down an opponent. David Coote had an easy-decision to make.
40' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
40' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
37' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
36' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and David Coote interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
34' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
28' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
25' A wild effort from Wilson Odobert (Burnley) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
24' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
23' Vitinho (Burnley) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
22' Burnley quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' The ball possession is 68:32.
13' 0 - 1 Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
12' Marcos Senesi is substituted due to injury. Andoni Iraola gives a chance to Chris Mepham (Bournemouth).
10' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
9' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) inside the box.
8' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
6' The corner from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is cleared away by the defence.

5' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Wilson Odobert (Burnley) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Neto was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' A yellow card for bad language! Dara O'Shea (Burnley) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
David Coote will referee today's match.
